hypothesis: 仅使用当前无标签截面状态检索历史相似截面，比最近窗口和随机历史截面更能恢复可迁移的截面排序信号。
causal_boundary: query t only uses X(t), library X(s) and y(s) with s before the evaluation window start; no Test labels and no X after t
local_metric: mean cross-sectional Spearman RankIC and delta versus frozen window baseline
expected_gain: retrieval correction beats random in every window and recent in at least three of four windows
failure_rule: any leakage/audit failure; retrieval not above random in every window; retrieval above recent in fewer than three windows; confidence-gain relationship unstable under leave-one-block-out

preregistered_parameters.confidence_pass_rule: median leave-one-block-out Spearman(confidence, retrieval_delta) > 0 and at least 75% of leave-one-block-out correlations are positive
